# My Koi Garden
> Practical koi knowledge for hobbyists: care, water quality, pond filtration, koi varieties, koi health, buying guidance, history, and local South Florida koi availability.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://mykoigarden.com/): Main guide hub for koi care, varieties, pond systems, health, and community.
- [Koi Care and Health](https://mykoigarden.com/koi-care/): Water quality, feeding, breeding, fry care, quarantine, disease prevention, and treatment decision support.
- [Koi Varieties](https://mykoigarden.com/koi-varieties/): Kohaku, Taisho Sanke, Showa, Tancho, Utsurimono, Bekko, Asagi, Ogon, longfin/butterfly koi, and non-Gosanke groups.
- [Pond Guide](https://mykoigarden.com/pond-guide/): Pond types, construction materials, mechanical filtration, biological filtration, UV, aeration, plants, and system planning.
- [Choose Koi](https://mykoigarden.com/choose-koi/): Koi selection process based on health, body shape, skin quality, fins, movement, pattern, and seller information.
- [Koi History](https://mykoigarden.com/koi-history/): Carp origins, Chinese carp culture, Japanese Nishikigoi development, major varieties, breeders, and global hobby history.
- [Common Koi Diseases](https://mykoigarden.com/koi-health/common-diseases.html): Parasites, fungal/water mold issues, bacterial problems, first checks, and professional-help warnings.
- [Local Koi for Sale](https://mykoigarden.com/local-koi-for-sale.html): Hobbyist-raised koi available for local pickup in South Florida near Davie, Weston, Southwest Ranches, Pembroke Pines, Cooper City, and Fort Lauderdale.
- [Sources](https://mykoigarden.com/sources.html): References, image credits, veterinary sources, and research material notes.

## Language versions
- English: https://mykoigarden.com/
- Chinese: https://mykoigarden.com/zh/
- Spanish: https://mykoigarden.com/es/
- Japanese: https://mykoigarden.com/ja/

## Editorial notes
- Health pages are educational and do not replace a veterinarian or qualified fish-health professional.
- Medication and antibiotic decisions should be based on water testing, diagnosis, and professional guidance when risk is high.
- Images and outside references are credited on page-level captions or the sources page.
